The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Elif speaks at Thornfield's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Jesse.
📓 Codex: Emberhold split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 3 petition at Haven's fire.
🧳 Emberhold has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northwest ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Lucia.
